name: Boneblade
body:
School necromancy [evil]; Level antipaladin 2, cleric/oracle 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a bone at least six-inches in length)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one bone that becomes a blade
Duration 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw Fort negates (object); Spell Resistance yes (object)

The caster changes a bone into a blade of the caster’s choosing. The boneblade may take the form of any weapon in the light blades or heavy blade fighter weapon groups. This weapon has a +1 enhancement bonus on attacks and damage for every five caster levels, minimum +1 and to a maximum of +4. The blade only gains enhancement bonuses and will not gain other weapon special abilities aside from the following.

This blade deals an extra + 1d6 points of damage to living targets and an additional + 1d6 points of damage to good-aligned targets.

This spell confers no proficiency with the blade, but the caster doesn’t need to be the one wielding the blade for it to be effective.
